english.note: Use this when a person's knowledge or understanding is limited and not deep, rather than when a thing is simply at an early stage.

examples.english: My knowledge of the law is rudimentary, so I don't dare give opinions casually.
examples.traditional: 我對法律嘅認識好粗淺，唔敢亂畀意見。
